# Steve Luce

Steve Luce is the current Deputy of [District 9](https://flow.je/elections/district-9) and was first elected to the States of Jersey in 2011.

Steve Luce has participated in 4 elections since 2002:

- [**2011 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/steve-luce#e15)

  Elected as Deputy of St Martin with 58.6% of the vote.

  - [2011 Vote.je Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20111114123845/http://www.vote.je:80/candidates/deputies/st-martin/steve-luce)
  - [2011 Full Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20110928133707/http://www.channel103.com:80/election/?page_id=97)
- [**2014 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/steve-luce#e20)

  Elected as Deputy of St Martin unopposed.

  - [2014 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2014/steve-luce-3/)
- [**2018 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/steve-luce#e42)

  Elected as Deputy of St Martin unopposed.

  - [2018 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2018/steve-luce-2/)
- [**2022 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/steve-luce#e48)

  Elected as Deputy of District 9 with 51.9% of the ballot.

  - [2022 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2022/steve-luce/)
  - [2022 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Kmeaz0-XlPA)

Steve Luce has declared his intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Senators Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026). \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/03/17/environment-minister-to-seek-senatorial-seat/)\]

- Twitter : [@DeputySteveLuce](https://twitter.com/DeputySteveLuce)

## Election History

### 2011 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy of [St Martin](https://flow.je/elections/st-martin) (1 seat), 7th September 2011.

**Steve Luce was elected as Deputy of St Martin in 2011**.

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **Steve Luce** |  | 1,008 | 58.6% |
| 2 | [Bob Hill BEM](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/bob-hill) |  | 709 | 41.2% |

1,720 votes (inc. 3 spoilt papers)

2,728 registered voters

= 63% turnout
